content: #1 I look forward to nLab’s take on Prof Andrew Hamilton’s TOE “A. J. S. Hamilton and T. McMaken. Unification of the four forces in the Spin(11,1) geometric algebra. Physica Scripta, submitted (2022)”, when it becomes available. There are some videos available, such as: https://youtu.be/0hohK2YIhPI. There is also the interesting and apparently related paper on “The Supergeometric Algebra” which is available at https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.11998.
